notes.text: Connor Brown is on injured reserve and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward. Anthony Mantha has taken his spot beside Jesper Bratt and Jack Hughes.

They dressed 11 forwards and 7 defensemen in 3 of their last 5 games, including the last one. Keegan Kolesar takes shifts on two lines, L3 and L4. Justin Faulk is the seventh defenseman, rotating in mostly beside Johansson and Chiarot.

stakes: The Devils go in tied for fifth in the Metropolitan with 4 points, the Red Wings eighth in the Atlantic with 3 points.

DET.head: Nothing to separate these two
DET.body: New Jersey is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Detroit has home-ice advantage. New Jersey has been out-chancing opponents lately, though. The Red Wings can tip it if they get good looks.

NJD.head: A genuine toss-up
NJD.body: New Jersey is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Detroit has home-ice advantage. New Jersey has been out-chancing opponents lately, though. For the Devils, the difference could be a power play that gets going.

items.text: The Devils are newly without Luke Evangelista, and have had to make do without Connor Brown all season.
The Red Wings have been without J.T. Compher since Oct 4, and have had to make do without Simon Edvinsson all season.
With J.T. Compher out, Emmitt Finnie took nine faceoffs in the Red Wings’ last game. He had been taking about two a game.
Nico Hischier is two goals from passing Travis Zajac for third on the Devils’ all-time goals list.
